$comment: Transcribed by hand from the SIA chart set AD 2 LFEB (AIP France, chart dated 2026-02-19): the text pages checked against the images of the pages.
Only what the chart states is recorded; nothing is deduced. Services, frequencies, elevation, position, magnetic variation and runways
were first extracted automatically from the chart text; the reporting points, rules and notes were added by hand.
The charts themselves are (c) SIA and are not redistributed. Flight simulation only: never use for real navigation.
The circuit side is not printed on this chart, so none is recorded. No reporting points are printed on this chart.
name: Dinan - Trélivan

source.extraction: manual, from the chart text and images

preferredQfuReason: preferred QFU 070 to avoid long landings on runway 25, which slopes downhill

circuit.lowHeight: training flights only, with an instructor on board: minimum 300 ft AAL
circuit.restrictions: traffic patterns for non-based aircraft only 0900-1100 and 1300-1700 (summer: minus 1 h); rotary-wing aircraft: minimum 1000 ft ASFC

departures.note: QFU 070: recommended to turn at the latest over the racecourse (hippodrome). QFU 250: continue on the axis to avoid overflying Trélivan.

notes: Aerodrome reserved for radio-equipped aircraft. Night VFR is not approved. No ATS: air-air frequency 119.765 only.
The chart also prints RENNES Approach 126.950 (above 2500 ft) and DINARD Tower 120.150 (1500 to 2500 ft); these are the units of other aerodromes and not services of Dinan-Trélivan.
Do not enter CTR 2 DINARD without clearance.
The aerodrome can be covered by sea haze within a few minutes.
An antenna lies in the runway axis: obstacle of 465 ft AMSL at 1.3 NM on bearing 254 from the aerodrome. Possible turbulence at the runway 07 threshold in crosswind.
Taxiing prohibited except on runways and taxiways. Taxiway B is usable only by aircraft whose main gear overall width is under 3 m.
Transient aircraft: use the grass apron except in periods of heavy rain. The first 3 stands of the paved apron near the hangar are reserved for the flying club.
AEM no. 8971 and parachuting no. 275: see ENR 5.5.
